campaigns.title: Emergency Medical Care & Surgery for Injured Strays
campaigns.description: Providing urgent medical treatment, life-saving surgeries, and intensive ICU care for street animals hit by vehicles or critical illnesses.

additionalCards.heading: State-of-the-Art Mobile Ambulance
additionalCards.description: Equipped with oxygen concentrators, stretchers, and emergency trauma kits to treat injured animals directly on site.

additionalCards.heading: 24/7 Dedicated Veterinary Doctors
additionalCards.description: Our team of compassionate veterinary surgeons work round-the-clock to perform emergency orthopedics and organ care.

additionalCards.heading: Post-Op Recovery Shelter
additionalCards.description: Hygienic recovery kennels with heating pads, specialized nutrition, and physical therapy for recovering strays.

campaigns.title: Daily Nourishment & Meal Drive for 1,000+ Street Animals
campaigns.description: Feeding wholesome, nutritious food daily to thousands of hungry dogs, cats, and birds across urban and rural animal shelters.

additionalCards.heading: Nutritious High-Protein Meal Prep
additionalCards.description: Freshly cooked rice, eggs, and veterinary-approved protein mixes prepared daily in our centralized community kitchen.

additionalCards.heading: Dedicated Meal Vans
additionalCards.description: Custom feeding routes covering over 45 urban sectors every single morning and evening without fail.

campaigns.title: Rabies Vaccination & ABC (Animal Birth Control) Program
campaigns.description: Humane population control and mass anti-rabies vaccination drives to protect stray dogs and community public health.

additionalCards.heading: Mass Anti-Rabies Drive
additionalCards.description: Over 5,000 stray dogs vaccinated annually with bright ear-tags for identification and tracking.

campaigns.title: Winter Coat & Cozy Shelter Protection Drive
campaigns.description: Distributing warm waterproof coats, straw bedding, and sheltered structures to protect homeless animals during harsh winter conditions.

additionalCards.heading: Waterproof Thermal Jackets
additionalCards.description: Custom durable jackets designed specifically for stray animals to retain body warmth in freezing temperatures.

campaigns.title: Clean Drinking Water Stations across the City
campaigns.description: Installing and maintaining 500+ cement water bowls in high-temperature areas so stray animals never suffer from dehydration.

campaigns.title: Cattle & Abandoned Farm Animal Sanctuary Expansion
campaigns.description: Expanding our sanctuary facilities to shelter old, rescued, and abandoned cattle and working animals with dignity.
